text: This is where the sentries go when they stop. I had them stacked. It seemed tidier than burying them.

Some of the ones in here are still on. I will not say which. The shutter wants light on its sensor and two cameras on the scale. I asked you nicely, for seven rooms, to come back. I have finished asking.
Two more for the pile. You are very good at making work for me. Go on. There is more. There is always more.
The panel assembly floor. Every white wall you ever put a hole in was made here. Nobody is making them now.
You left the track, so the examination has come to you. One crate, in a pen. One shutter, a long way from it. Everything I could find is in between.
